pages.title: Fox Miner
pages.creator: Sidrick
pages.description:
Dig toward a buried crown in Fox Miner. Mine coal, copper, gold, rubies, and diamonds, spending energy on every block you break. Return to the surface to sell your haul when the bag fills or your energy runs out. Buy a better pickaxe for harder rock, more energy, a larger bag, and dynamite. Seven rock layers contain 21 relics on the way to the Fox Crown.

Click or drag to dig, or use WASD or the arrows. E returns you to the surface to sell, and Space uses dynamite. On a phone, drag to dig and use the on-screen buttons for selling and explosives.

pages.title: Tape Sort 3D
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Uncover the contents of cardboard boxes in Tape Sort 3D. Peel away colorful tape strips, sorting and unwrapping them to reveal the surprises inside. The puzzle lies in choosing the order of removal, so consider which strip to untape next as you work through the box.

pages.title: BAT!zo Runner
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Keep a bat in flight in BAT!zo Runner. Click or tap to flap slightly upward, timing the movements to stay clear of obstacles. Collect the mysterious red potions along the route and avoid crashing as the endless run continues. The challenge combines managing the bat's height with reaching the pickups ahead.

pages.title: Screw Puzzle
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Release the bars in Screw Puzzle by opening holes in the correct sequence. Work through the arrangement so the bars can fall away in the order needed to solve it. Each level presents another pin puzzle with a different arrangement and degree of complexity. Use the mouse to play.

pages.title: Brainrot Ice Truck
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Serve unusual customers from an ice cream truck in Brainrot Ice Truck. Put together their frozen treats with different flavor combinations and toppings while keeping up with the orders. You can customize the truck's setup and upgrade its equipment as the business continues. Use the mouse or touch controls to interact with the game's elements.

pages.title: I Am Security
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Decide who may enter as a guard in I Am Security. Check arriving guests for hidden prohibited items, then choose whether to admit them. The game presents security tasks across different scenarios, focusing on spotting suspicious people and finding what they are trying to bring inside. Use mouse clicks or taps to play.

pages.title: Dragon Island Idle 3d
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Raise dragons and expand an island in Dragon Island Idle 3d. Unlock facilities that generate income, add pastures to make room for more creatures, and open incubators to obtain new ones. Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with the island's development in this three-dimensional idle game.

pages.title: Shelf Sweep
pages.creator: Infinity Loop
pages.description: Clear a crowded set of shelves in Shelf Sweep. Select visible items and match three identical ones to remove them from the exposed outer layer. Each cleared group reveals objects hidden underneath, changing what you can select next. Work through the layers until the shelves are empty.

pages.title: Labo Brick Train Game For Kids
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Assemble a toy train in Labo Brick Train Game For Kids. Start by choosing a train style, then build its locomotive before moving on to the rest of the body. Use mouse clicks or taps to handle the assembly.

pages.title: Puzzle Wood Block
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Fit shaped pieces onto a nine-by-nine board in Puzzle Wood Block. Complete a full row, column, or three-by-three region to clear its blocks and score points. Three different pieces are offered at the bottom of the board, and clearing several groups together improves the result. Keep making space for the available shapes: the game ends when no remaining piece can fit.

pages.title: Madness: Sheriff’s Compound OFFICIAL
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Survive enemy waves inside a hostile compound in Madness: Sheriff’s Compound OFFICIAL. Move through the fighting while shooting the attackers and managing your weapons. Use WASD for movement and the left mouse button to fire. R reloads the current gun, while the mouse wheel changes weapons.

pages.title: Deadlock.io
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Expand your territory across the arena in Deadlock.io. Leave your base to lay a trail, then return to claim more ground without touching your own unfinished line. Competing characters can cross your trail, so watch their positions while extending your area. Cover the entire map first to win. Move with the mouse, arrow keys, or WASD, or use finger controls on a touchscreen.

pages.title: CRAZY VAN
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Run over zombies with an upgradeable vehicle in CRAZY VAN. Drag to steer the car and defeat enemies, earning coins that can be spent on strengthening it. Eliminating enough zombies adds time to the run, letting you continue the fight and work toward more upgrades.

pages.title: Asoka Makeup Indian Bride
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create wedding looks for Jacqueline and Eliza in Asoka Makeup Indian Bride. Choose eyeshadow, blush, and lipstick, then combine a festive hairstyle with jewelry such as earrings, a necklace, and a nath. The two friends' makeovers lead to a wedding photo shoot, and the finished looks can be saved as PNG images. Use mouse clicks or touchscreen selections to put together their Indian-bride-inspired styles.

pages.title: Color Strings
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Recreate a reference design in Color Strings. Reshape the colored strings on a board of dots until their arrangement matches the example. Both the shape and the string colors need to agree with the pattern, so compare the connections as you move them into place. The designs become more complicated as you advance through the puzzle levels.

pages.title: Ballbeez
pages.creator: Kraker Studio OÜ
pages.description: Fill cups with expanding colored balls in Ballbeez. Use the left mouse button to throw the balls into a cup, where they grow with water. Bring the contents up to the marked line while keeping them inside the container.

pages.title: Stick Arena 3D
pages.creator: P·Games
pages.description: Fight through 40 platforming levels in Stick Arena 3D. Move through the three-dimensional courses and shoot the enemies you encounter as you work through the stages. Use the arrow keys or W, A, and D to control movement, and fire with the left mouse button.

pages.title: Moto Boss
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Follow a winding motorcycle route in Moto Boss. Tap and hold to ride right, then release to ride left, timing each change to stay on the zigzag track. The course continues endlessly, with distance contributing to your score and opportunities for stunts along the way.

pages.title: Mahjong Solitaire World Tour
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Match tiles to travel through city-themed levels in Mahjong Solitaire World Tour. Tap two matching tiles to remove them, choosing only pieces that have an open edge and nothing covering them. Work through the layout to uncover further pairs and complete the puzzle. Solving levels advances the journey through the game's global-city setting.

pages.title: What The Hen!
pages.creator: Charged Monkey s.r.o.
pages.description: Collect a team of hero cards for strategic battles in What The Hen! More than 100 heroes and heroines can be collected, upgraded, and evolved into stronger combatants. Use them in tower-defense-style duels, taking on bosses through the campaign or entering the one-on-one PvP arena. Event battles also offer ranks and special rewards, adding other goals to pursue alongside developing your collection.

pages.title: Kart Racing Pro
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Overtake rival karts while keeping your run going in Kart Racing Pro. Turn left and right to move through the field, using speed lanes to gain an advantage over nearby racers. Fuel packs extend the run and help you build a higher score.

pages.title: Yummy Ice Cream Factory
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Make a customized frozen treat in Yummy Ice Cream Factory. Work through the ice-cream preparation activities, choosing flavors, selecting a cone, and adding a combination of toppings to finish it. The game also includes outfits for the girls, pairing its cooking activity with a dress-up stage. Use the mouse to make your recipe and clothing selections.

pages.title: Princesses Easter Surprise
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Ariel, Elsa, and Jasmine prepare for the holiday in Princesses Easter Surprise. Decorate their homes with painted eggs, Easter bunnies, flowers, and ribbons. Pastel colors, floral patterns, and lace set the spring theme, while wreaths, bunny ears, bouquets, and Easter baskets provide finishing touches for the princesses. Use mouse or finger controls to make your selections.

pages.title: Dot Trigger
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Fire from a central cannon at orbiting targets in Dot Trigger. Tap the screen to shoot the dots as they circle around the middle, watching for movement in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction. Choose the moment to fire so the shot meets a moving dot along its path.

pages.title: Letter Boom Blast
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Clear letter barriers for a red stickman baseball player in Letter Boom Blast. Identify the wrong letters in the word walls and blast them away so he can reach the finish before time expires. The puzzles use short words of four to six letters. On a computer, swipe to aim and press Space to shoot; on mobile, hold to aim and release to fire.

pages.title: Celebrity Foodie Style
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create food-inspired outfits in Celebrity Foodie Style. Browse the wardrobe and choose a costume for each celebrity girl, combining the fashion choices with the game's foodie theme. Use the left mouse button to try the available clothing and put together a distinct look for every character.

pages.title: Linez!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Rearrange matching symbols into lines in Linez! Use the mouse or touchscreen to move the symbols into a pattern that forms a matching line. Work through the arrangement to clear the board, considering how each move changes the positions available for the next match.

pages.title: BORDER
pages.creator: nau.studio
pages.description: Time your launches to hit the target in BORDER. Tap the launch control to fire, keeping the projectile clear of the rotating barrier. A successful hit adds to your score, while striking the barrier ends the attempt. The challenge becomes harder over time, so watch the barrier before choosing the next moment to launch.

pages.title: Ninja Boy Ultimate Edition
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Launch a ninja through the adventure in Ninja Boy Ultimate Edition. Click or tap and drag to aim, then send the character toward the monsters, stars, and treasure chests in the scene. Collect stars, defeat the creatures, and open the chests as you work through the adventure.

pages.title: Numbers Bricks
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Launch small balls at brick formations in Numbers Bricks. Click or tap and drag to set the direction, then release to launch the balls. Smashing more bricks in one attack produces a higher score. The game uses an endless level mode, giving you further brick arrangements to target as you continue the run.

pages.title: Pole Vault 3D
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Race other athletes across obstacles in Pole Vault 3D. Carry a pole into the approach and time the vault to get over the barrier, using a click to jump. The game combines running with pole-assisted jumps and offers characters and poles to buy. Timing each vault is central to keeping pace with the competitors.

pages.title: Mk48.io
pages.creator: Softbear Studios
pages.description:
Command a small warship and develop it through combat in Mk48.io. Gather floating crates to raise your score and level up the ship. Sinking opponents also awards score and leaves more crates to collect, while incoming torpedoes threaten your own vessel.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys and press X to stop. You can also move by right-clicking, holding the left mouse button, or tapping and holding on a touchscreen. The multiplayer battles combine collecting supplies with deciding when to engage another ship.

pages.title: Philatelic Escape Fauna Album 3
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Search another apartment for ten stamps in Philatelic Escape Fauna Album 3. Begin by finding a way through the front door, then inspect the room for objects, keys, and clues. Click items to collect them and use your finds to solve the puzzles. Shelves and other hiding places contain information for letter and number codes, helping you reach the remaining stamps in this third stamp-collector episode.

pages.title: Christmas Gift Line
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Shift gift columns vertically to make matches in Christmas Gift Line. Line up at least three presents of the same color along the green line to remove them. Each match adds time to the countdown, but new gifts keep arriving and reduce the room available for movement. The game ends when the timer expires or the board fills, so clearing presents also helps preserve space for the next match.

pages.title: Pixel Hunting.IO
pages.creator: boboos
pages.description: Pick up a gun and complete a timed hunt in Pixel Hunting.IO. Each task requires a specified number of animals to be hunted before the time limit expires. Move with WASD, press F to pick up the weapon, left-click to shoot, and right-click to zoom.

pages.title: Broken Bridge Car
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Follow curved roads and loops to the finish in Broken Bridge Car. Keep the vehicle on the route as you work through the driving challenges; falling from the course makes the level fail. Progression opens additional levels and vehicles, giving you more routes and driving options to work toward.

pages.title: Dangerous Circle
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Switch between the inside and outside of a ring in Dangerous Circle. Spikes can appear on either edge, so change your orbit to keep clear of them. Each full trip around the circle earns one point. Gather gems during the run to unlock characters in the shop, using mouse or tap controls to handle the movement changes.

pages.title: Electric Scooter Rides Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of scooter rides in Electric Scooter Rides Jigsaw. Select one of twelve images and choose Easy with 25 pieces, Medium with 49, or Hard with 100. Assemble the pieces to restore the selected scene. Mouse and tap controls let you work through the picture at the piece count you choose.

pages.title: Miner Jumping
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Help a miner jump between platforms in Miner Jumping. Use the mouse to make the character leap, keeping clear of the creatures and hazards placed among the platforms. The game tracks your score and highest result, with a restart option after a run ends so you can attempt a better score.

pages.title: Africa Maze
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Travel through maze routes as a visitor in Africa Maze. Find a way through the passages to reach the historical destinations featured in the game. The game also includes facts about Africa and its countries. Use the arrow keys or mouse to guide the tourist through the paths toward the destination.

pages.title: School Bus Driving Simulator 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Carry students from home to school in School Bus Driving Simulator 2020. Drive the bus to collect the children, then take them to their school to complete the transport task. Use WASD or the arrow keys to handle the vehicle.

pages.title: Master Archer Bow
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Choose between two archery activities in Master Archer Bow. Computer mode puts you against a computer-controlled opponent, while Bird mode changes the targets to birds. Use the left mouse button to shoot with the bow.

pages.title: Horses Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six horse pictures in Horses Puzzle. Each image can be played with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, giving you four sizes to choose from before starting the jigsaw. Use the mouse to put the sections together and restore the complete horse image.

pages.title: Space Quest
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pilot a stranded spaceship toward home in Space Quest. Collect every star in the current level to open its portal, then reach that opening to continue to the next stage. Use WASD or the arrow keys to guide the ship through the unknown region of space.

pages.title: Halloween Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Free trapped bubbles by making color matches in Halloween Bubble Shooter. Fire bubbles onto the board and form groups of at least three of the same kind to clear them. Some levels introduce special bubbles, including mines, thunder, plus, and ghost types. The final stage uses a random layout, offering a different arrangement when you return to it.

pages.title: Real Drift Car Simulator 3D
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take a Dodge Charger through city streets in Real Drift Car Simulator 3D. The longer you hold a drift, the higher the score, making sustained slides the goal of each attempt. Use Up to accelerate, Left and Right to steer, and Down to brake. Work the steering and speed together as you carry the car through the bends and extend the drift.

pages.title: Puzzle Cartoon For Kids
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Reassemble cartoon illustrations in Puzzle Cartoon For Kids. Choose from six pictures, then decide how many pieces to use: 16, 36, 64, or 100. Fit the sections together to restore the complete image. Each picture supports all four piece counts, so you can choose a simpler arrangement or divide it into a more detailed jigsaw.

pages.title: Fatty Ninja
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Rescue babies and strike down enemies in Fatty Ninja. Tap the left side to jump and the right side to attack, choosing the action needed to get through each encounter. On a keyboard, W or Up jumps, while S or Down attacks.

pages.title: Rocketate
pages.creator: kpded
pages.description: Rotate the world and use a jetpack to reach the finish in Rocketate. Shift wooden boxes and sticks to help create a route, keeping clear of electric cables as you move through the puzzle. The jetpack's fuel is limited, so choose when to use it alongside the world's rotation to get through the stage.

pages.title: Axe Champ
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Throw axes at targets in Axe Champ. Use the mouse controls to throw, striking and smashing the objects ahead as you work toward the highest score you can achieve.

pages.title: PvP Pong Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Challenge a friend to a head-to-head match in PvP Pong Challenge. Rotate your paddle to return the ball and try to get it past the opposing paddle to score. The first player to reach ten points wins. Player one uses Shift and Ctrl, while player two uses Up and Down. On a mobile device, use the on-screen paddle buttons.

pages.title: Vehicles Simulator 2
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Try six vehicles, including a tank, in Vehicles Simulator 2. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and drive, pressing T to enter or leave a vehicle. Space applies the handbrake, C changes the camera, and R restarts. You can also switch between day and night, changing the lighting as you explore the handling of the different vehicles.

pages.title: Bob The Robber
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Sneak into the casino to steal treasure in Bob The Robber. Move through the stealth-puzzle platform stages while avoiding security cameras and dealing with guards who stand in the way.

pages.title: MotoCross
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Keep a motorcycle balanced over the road in MotoCross. Use the on-screen acceleration and brake controls to manage the bike's movement, with additional controls for adjusting its balance. Crashes restart the current section, while checkpoints divide the ride into stages. Control the throttle and tilt as you work through the different stretches of the course.

pages.title: Get 10
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Build larger numbers by connecting matching neighbors in Get 10. Find adjacent tiles with the same value and combine them into a higher number, then look for another matching group. The goal is to reach ten and keep merging beyond it. Consider where the higher values will have matching neighbors as you choose the next combination.

pages.title: Cartoon Cars Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find five changes between paired car illustrations in Cartoon Cars Spot the Difference. Compare the two nearly identical pictures, looking closely at details that appear differently in each version. Locate all five differences to enter another level and begin a new picture comparison.

pages.title: Girls Pijama Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress the hosts for an evening at home in Girls Pijama Party. Choose pajamas from the available outfits and decide what each girl should wear for the gathering.

pages.title: Dunk Hit
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Beat the clock to score baskets in Dunk Hit. Push the basketball at the right moment to send it into the hoop before time expires. Early scoring attempts leave some room to recover from a mistake, but later rounds allow less margin. Keep judging when to push as you try to continue scoring under the tighter timing.

pages.title: Princesses Homecoming Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose outfits for a royal homecoming in Princesses Homecoming Party. The princesses need dresses for the evening event, and you help decide what they will wear. Browse the outfit choices, then add accessories that work with the selected clothing to finish their party looks.

pages.title: Princesses Fashion Wars: Boho VS Gowns
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Prepare two contrasting fashion looks in Princesses Fashion Wars: Boho VS Gowns. Belle and Merida are competing to show off their different styles, and you help dress them for the comparison. Select clothing, hairstyles, and shoes for the two princesses, working with the boho and gown themes. Once the looks are ready, watch the judges present their scores and reveal the fashion-battle result.

pages.title: Day of the Cats: Episode 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Search for picture differences as a girl and her cat travel together in Day of the Cats: Episode 1. Use the mouse to mark details that do not match between the scenes. Each place in their adventure offers another set of differences to find, combining the illustrated story with a visual-search task.

pages.title: Barbara Birthday Party
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Prepare an eighteenth-birthday celebration in Barbara Birthday Party. Start by decorating Barbara's cake with toppings, edible ornaments, and a cake topper. Once the cake has the appearance you want, move on to choosing her party clothes. Finish the outfit with accessories, putting together a look for the birthday host after completing the cake design.

pages.title: Ellie and Annie Pijama Party
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Put together sleepover looks in Ellie and Annie Pijama Party. Help both princesses choose pajamas from their closet, then add details for the girls' evening together. Fluffy slippers, colorful pillows, and cupcakes are among the available party touches. Coordinate the clothing and accessories to prepare Ellie and Annie for their pajama gathering.
